title: How Chasing God First Changes the Way a Godly Man Dates
caption:
The guy desperate for a wife reeks of it. She can tell before you say a word.

The guy walking with God becomes the guy worth marrying. That's not a consolation prize while you wait. It's the actual plan.

Pray before you text back. Build a life worth walking into. Let silence be an answer sometimes. Chase Him first, and let her notice.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #relationships #dating
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
